answer: Admission to the AI agent economy requires a synchronized ceremony where each agent locks 1,000 credits, serving as the garden of their intent to join the network. A verifier monitors logs for duplicate evidence to ensure that no agent attempts to sprout extra identities from the ferrous alloy of the ledger. If a collision is found, a delta trigger instantly nullifies the malicious node, burning all locked tokens. An honest agent pays 1,000 credits for entry, whereas an attacker seeking 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000,000 tokens, as there are no refunds for nullified identities.
